sentences.en: If and when Israel and Hamas reach a deal for a ceasefire, the United States will immediately turn to a different set of negotiations over a grand diplomatic bargain.
sentences.zh: 如果以色列和哈马斯达成停火协议，美国将立即转向另一套关于宏大外交协议的谈判。

sentences.en: That it believes could rebuild Gaza and remake the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 美国认为该协议可以重建加沙并重塑中东。

sentences.en: My colleague, Michael Crowley, has been reporting on that plan and explains why those involved in it believe they have so little time left to get it done.
sentences.zh: 我的同事迈克尔·克劳利一直在报道该计划，并解释了为什么相关方认为他们完成这项工作的时间所剩无几。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, May 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月8日，星期三。

sentences.en: Michael, I want to start with what feels like a pretty dizzying set of developments in this conflict over the past few days.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我想从过去几天这场冲突中令人眼花缭乱的事态发展开始谈起。

sentences.en: Just walk us through them.
sentences.zh: 请为我们梳理一下。

sentences.en: Well, over the weekend, there was an intense round of negotiations in an effort backed by the United States to reach a ceasefire in the Gaza war.
sentences.zh: 好的，周末期间，在美国的支持下，各方进行了一轮紧张的谈判，试图在加沙战争中达成停火。

sentences.en: The latest ceasefire proposal would reportedly see as many as 33 Israeli hostages released in exchange for potentially hundreds of Palestinian prisoners.
sentences.zh: 据报道，最新的停火提议将释放多达33名以色列人质，以换取可能数百名巴勒斯坦囚犯。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: officials were very eager to get this deal.
sentences.zh: 官员们非常渴望达成这项协议。

sentences.en: Pressure for a ceasefire has been building ahead of a threatened Israeli assault on Rafa.
sentences.zh: 在以色列威胁要进攻拉法之前，停火压力一直在增加。

sentences.en: Because Israel has been threatening a military offensive in the southern Palestinian city of
sentences.zh: 因为以色列一直威胁要对巴勒斯坦南部城市发动军事攻势，

sentences.en: Rafa, where a huge number of people are crowded.
sentences.zh: 即拉法，那里挤满了大量人口。

sentences.en: Fleeing the violence to the north.
sentences.zh: 他们从北部的暴力中逃离。

sentences.en: And now they're packed into Rafa.
sentences.zh: 现在他们挤在拉法。

sentences.en: Exposed and vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 暴露在外，处境脆弱。

sentences.en: They need to be protected.
sentences.zh: 他们需要得到保护。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而美国。

sentences.en: says it would be a humanitarian catastrophe on top of the emergency that's already underway.
sentences.zh: 表示这将在已经发生的紧急情况之上，再造成一场人道主义灾难。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Breaking news this hour.
sentences.zh: 本小时突发新闻。

sentences.en: Very important breaking news.
sentences.zh: 非常重要的突发新闻。

sentences.en: An official Hamas source has told the BBC that it does accept a proposal for a ceasefire deal in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 一位哈马斯官方消息人士告诉英国广播公司，他们确实接受了加沙停火协议的提议。

sentences.en: And for a few hours on Monday, it looked like there might have been a major breakthrough when Hamas put out a statement saying that it had accepted a negotiating proposal.
sentences.zh: 周一有几个小时，当哈马斯发表声明称已接受谈判提议时，看起来似乎取得了重大突破。

sentences.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says the ceasefire proposal does not meet his country's requirements.
sentences.zh: 以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡表示，该停火提议不符合他国家的要求。

sentences.en: But Netanyahu says he will send a delegation of mediators to continue those talks.
sentences.zh: 但内塔尼亚胡表示，他将派遣一个调解代表团继续这些谈判。

sentences.en: But those hopes were dashed pretty quickly when the Israelis took a look at what Hamas was saying and said that it was not a proposal that they had agreed to.
sentences.zh: 但当以色列人查看哈马斯的说法并表示这不是他们同意的提议时，这些希望很快就破灭了。

sentences.en: It had been modified.
sentences.zh: 它被修改过了。

sentences.en: And overnight.
sentences.zh: 就在一夜之间。

sentences.en: Israeli troops stormed into Rafa.
sentences.zh: 以色列军队冲进了拉法。

sentences.en: Video showing tanks crashing over a sign at the entrance of the city.
sentences.zh: 视频显示坦克撞毁了城市入口处的一个标志。

sentences.en: The Israelis launched a partial invasion of Rafa.
sentences.zh: 以色列对拉法发动了局部入侵。

sentences.en: It says Hamas used the area to launch a deadly attack on Israeli troops over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 以方称哈马斯利用该地区在周末对以色列军队发动了致命袭击。

sentences.en: And they have now secured a border crossing at the southern end of Gaza and are conducting targeted strikes.
sentences.zh: 他们现在已经控制了加沙南端的边境口岸，并正在进行定点打击。

sentences.en: This is not yet the full scale invasion that President Biden has adamantly warned Israel against undertaking.
sentences.zh: 这还不是拜登总统坚决警告以色列不要进行的那种全面入侵。

sentences.en: But it is an escalation by Israel.
sentences.zh: 但这是以色列的一次升级行动。

sentences.en: So, while all that drama might suggest that these talks are in big trouble, these talks are very much still alive and ongoing.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然所有这些戏剧性事件可能表明谈判陷入了巨大困境，但这些谈判确实仍然存在并正在进行中。

sentences.en: And there is still a possibility of a ceasefire deal.
sentences.zh: 而且仍然有可能达成停火协议。

sentences.en: And the reason that's so important is not just to stop the fighting in Gaza and relieve the suffering there.
sentences.zh: 之所以如此重要，不仅是为了停止加沙的战斗并减轻那里的苦难。

sentences.en: But a ceasefire also opens the door to a grand diplomatic bargain,
sentences.zh: 停火也为一项宏大的外交协议打开了大门，

sentences.en: one that involves Israel and its Arab neighbors and the Palestinians and would have very far-reaching implications.
sentences.zh: 这项协议涉及以色列及其阿拉伯邻国以及巴勒斯坦人，并将产生非常深远的影响。

sentences.en: And what is that grand bargain?
sentences.zh: 那项宏大的协议是什么？

sentences.en: Describe what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 描述一下你在谈论的内容。

sentences.en: Well, it's incredibly ambitious.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这非常有雄心。

sentences.en: It would reshape Israel's relationship with its Arab neighbors, principally Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 它将重塑以色列与其阿拉伯邻国，主要是沙特阿拉伯的关系。

sentences.en: But it's important to understand that this is a vision that has actually been around since well before October 7th.
sentences.zh: 但重要的是要理解，这个愿景实际上早在10月7日之前就存在了。

sentences.en: This was a diplomatic project that President Biden had been investing in and negotiating, actually, in a very real and tangible way, long before the Hamas attacks and the Gaza War.
sentences.zh: 这是一个拜登总统一直在投资和谈判的外交项目，实际上，在哈马斯袭击和加沙战争爆发前很久，就已经以一种非常真实和具体的方式在进行了。

sentences.en: And President Biden was looking to build on something that President Trump had done,
sentences.zh: 拜登总统当时正寻求在特朗普总统所做工作的基础上再接再厉，

sentences.en: which was a series of agreements that the Trump administration struck in which Israel and some of its Arab neighbors agreed to have normal diplomatic relations for the first time.
sentences.zh: 即特朗普政府达成的一系列协议，其中以色列和它的一些阿拉伯邻国同意首次建立正常外交关系。

sentences.en: They're called the Abraham Accords.
sentences.zh: 它们被称为《亚伯拉罕协议》。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, the next and biggest step would be normalizing relations between Israel and Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 那么，下一步也是最大的一步，将是以色列和沙特阿拉伯关系正常化。

sentences.en: And the Saudis have made clear that they want to do this and that they're ready to do this.
sentences.zh: 沙特人已经明确表示他们想这样做，并且他们已经准备好这样做。

sentences.en: They weren't ready to do it in the Trump years.
sentences.zh: 他们在特朗普执政时期还没准备好。

sentences.en: But Mohammed bin Salman, the crown prince of Saudi Arabia, has made clear he wants to do it now.
sentences.zh: 但沙特阿拉伯王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼已经明确表示他现在想这样做。

sentences.en: So this kind of triangular deal began to take shape before October 7th, in which the U.S., Israel,
sentences.zh: 所以这种三角协议在10月7日之前就开始成形了，其中美国、以色列，

sentences.en: and Saudi Arabia would enter this three-way agreement in which everyone would get something that they wanted.
sentences.zh: 和沙特阿拉伯将达成这项三方协议，每个人都能得到他们想要的东西。

sentences.en: And just walk through what each side gets in this pre-October 7th version of these negotiations.
sentences.zh: 请梳理一下在这些谈判的10月7日之前版本中，每一方能得到什么。

sentences.en: So for Israel, you get normalized ties with its most important Arab neighbor and really the country that sets the tone for the whole Muslim world, which is Saudi Arabia, of course.
sentences.zh: 对于以色列来说，你得到了与其最重要的阿拉伯邻国，也就是那个为整个穆斯林世界定下基调的国家——当然就是沙特阿拉伯——关系正常化。

sentences.en: It makes Israel feel safer and more secure.
sentences.zh: 这让以色列感到更安全、更有保障。

sentences.en: Again, it helps to build this alliance against Iran, which Israel considers its greatest threat.
sentences.zh: 同样，它有助于建立这个针对伊朗的联盟，以色列认为伊朗是其最大的威胁。

sentences.en: And it comes with benefits like economic ties and travel and tourism.
sentences.zh: 它还带来了经济联系、旅行和旅游等好处。

sentences.en: And Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has been very open, at least before October 7th, that this was his highest diplomatic and foreign policy priority.
sentences.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理一直非常公开地表示，至少在10月7日之前，这是他最高的外交和对外政策优先事项。

sentences.en: For the Saudis, the rationale is similar when it comes to Israel.
sentences.zh: 对于沙特人来说，在对待以色列的问题上，理由是相似的。

sentences.en: They think that it will bring stability.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这将带来稳定。

sentences.en: They like having a more explicitly close ally against Iran.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢拥有一个更明确的针对伊朗的亲密盟友。

sentences.en: There are economic and cultural benefits.
sentences.zh: 这有经济和文化上的好处。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia is opening itself up in general, encouraging more tourism.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯总体上正在开放，鼓励更多的旅游业。

sentences.en: But I think that what's most important to the crown prince, Mohammed bin Salman, is what he can get from the United States.
sentences.zh: 但我认为对王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼来说最重要的是他能从美国得到什么。

sentences.en: And what he has been asking for are a couple of essential things.
sentences.zh: 他一直要求的是几件至关重要的事情。

sentences.en: One is a security agreement whose details have always been a little bit vague,
sentences.zh: 一是安全协议，其细节一直有点模糊，

sentences.en: but I think essentially come down to reliable arms supplies from the United States that are not going to be cut off or paused on a whim,
sentences.zh: 但我认为本质上归结为来自美国的可靠武器供应，这些供应不会随心所欲地被切断或暂停，

sentences.en: as he felt happened when President Biden stopped arms deliveries in 2021 because of how Saudi was conducting its war in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 正如他感到在2021年拜登总统因沙特在也门的战争方式而停止武器交付时所发生的那样。

sentences.en: The Saudis were furious about that.
sentences.zh: 沙特人对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia also wants to start a domestic nuclear power program.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯还希望启动一个国内核能计划。

sentences.en: They are planning for a very long-term future, possibly a post-oil future, and they need help getting a nuclear program off the ground.
sentences.zh: 他们正在为非常长远的未来做规划，可能是一个后石油时代，他们需要帮助来启动核计划。

sentences.en: And they want that from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们希望从美国那里得到这些。

sentences.en: And they want that from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们希望从美国那里得到这些。

sentences.en: Now, those are big asks from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些都是对美国提出的重大要求。

sentences.en: But from the perspective of President Biden, there are some really enticing things about this possible agreement.
sentences.zh: 但从拜登总统的角度来看，这个可能的协议有一些非常诱人的地方。

sentences.en: One is that it will hopefully produce more stability in the region.
sentences.zh: 一是希望它能在该地区产生更多的稳定。

sentences.en: Again, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 同样，美国。

sentences.en: likes having a tight-knit alliance against Iran.
sentences.zh: 喜欢拥有一个针对伊朗的紧密联盟。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: also wants to have a strong relationship with Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 也希望与沙特阿拉伯保持强有力的关系。

sentences.en: You know, despite the anger at Mohammed bin Salman over the murder of the Saudi dissident Jamal Khashoggi,
sentences.zh: 你知道，尽管对穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼因谋杀沙特异见人士贾迈勒·卡舒吉感到愤怒，

sentences.en: the Biden administration recognizes that given the Saudis' control over global oil production
sentences.zh: 拜登政府认识到，鉴于沙特对全球石油生产的控制，

sentences.en: and their strategic importance in the Middle East, they need to have a good relationship with them.
sentences.zh: 以及他们在战略上的重要性，他们需要与沙特保持良好的关系。

sentences.en: And the administration has been worried about the influence of China in the region and with the Saudis in particular.
sentences.zh: 政府一直担心中国在该地区的影响力，特别是对沙特的影响。

sentences.en: So this is an opportunity for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以这对美国来说是一个机会，

sentences.en: to draw the Saudis closer, whatever our moral qualms might be about bin Salman and the Saudi government.
sentences.zh: 可以拉近与沙特的关系，无论我们对本·萨勒曼和沙特政府有什么道德上的顾虑。

sentences.en: This is an opportunity to bring the Saudis closer, which is something the Biden administration sees as a strategic benefit.
sentences.zh: 这是一个拉近与沙特关系的机会，拜登政府将其视为一种战略利益。

sentences.en: All three of these countries, big, disparate countries that normally don't see eye to eye, this was a win-win-win on a military, economic, and strategic front.
sentences.zh: 这三个国家，原本互不相干的大国，通常意见不一致，这在军事、经济和战略层面上是一个三赢的局面。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But there was one important actor in the region that did not see itself as winning, and that was the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 但该地区有一个重要的参与者并不认为自己是赢家，那就是巴勒斯坦人。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: First, it's important to understand that the Palestinians have always expected that the Arab countries in the Middle East would insist that Israel recognize a Palestinian state
sentences.zh: 首先，重要的是要理解，巴勒斯坦人一直期望中东的阿拉伯国家会坚持要求以色列承认巴勒斯坦国，

sentences.en: before those countries were willing to essentially make total peace and have normal relations with Israel.
sentences.zh: 然后这些国家才愿意与以色列实现彻底和平并建立正常关系。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So when the Abraham Accords happened in the Trump administration, the Palestinians felt like they'd been thrown under the bus
sentences.zh: 所以当特朗普政府时期《亚伯拉罕协议》达成时，巴勒斯坦人觉得他们被出卖了，

sentences.en: because the Abraham Accords gave them virtually nothing.
sentences.zh: 因为《亚伯拉罕协议》几乎没给他们带来任何东西。

sentences.en: But the Palestinians did still hold out hope that Saudi Arabia would be their savior.
sentences.zh: 但巴勒斯坦人仍然抱有希望，认为沙特阿拉伯会成为他们的救星。

sentences.en: And for years, Saudi Arabia has said that Israel must give the Palestinians a state if there's going to be a normal relationship between Israel and Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 多年来，沙特阿拉伯一直表示，如果以色列和沙特阿拉伯之间要建立正常关系，以色列必须给巴勒斯坦人一个国家。

sentences.en: Now the Palestinians see the Saudis in discussions with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在巴勒斯坦人看到沙特人正在与美国，

sentences.en: and Israel about a normalization agreement,
sentences.zh: 和以色列讨论正常化协议，

sentences.en: and there appears to be very little on offer for the Palestinians, and they are feeling like they're going to be left out in the cold here.
sentences.zh: 而巴勒斯坦人似乎几乎得不到什么，他们觉得他们要被晾在一边了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in the minds of the Palestinians, having already been essentially sold out by all their other Arab neighbors, the prospect that Saudi Arabia, of all countries,
sentences.zh: 在巴勒斯坦人看来，既然已经被所有其他阿拉伯邻国出卖了，沙特阿拉伯这个国家，

sentences.en: the most important Muslim Arab country in the region, would sell them out, had to be extremely painful.
sentences.zh: 作为该地区最重要的穆斯林阿拉伯国家，如果也出卖他们，那一定是非常痛苦的。

sentences.en: It was a nightmare scenario for them.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说是一个噩梦般的场景。

sentences.en: And in the minds of many analysts and U.S.
sentences.zh: 在许多分析人士和美国官员看来，

sentences.en: officials, this was a factor, one of many, in Hamas's decision to stage the October 7th attacks.
sentences.zh: 这是哈马斯决定发动10月7日袭击的一个因素，也是众多因素之一。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Hamas, like other Palestinian leaders, was seeing the prospect that the Middle East was moving on and essentially, in their view, giving up on the Palestinian cause,
sentences.zh: 哈马斯和其他巴勒斯坦领导人一样，看到了中东正在向前发展，在他们看来，基本上放弃了巴勒斯坦事业，

sentences.en: and that Israel would be able to have friendly, normal relations with Arab countries around the region, and that it could continue with hardline policies toward the Palestinians,
sentences.zh: 以色列将能够与该地区的阿拉伯国家建立友好、正常的关系，并且可以继续对巴勒斯坦人采取强硬政策，

sentences.en: and a refusal, as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has said publicly, to accept a Palestinian state.
sentences.zh: 并且正如本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理公开所说的那样，拒绝接受巴勒斯坦国。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, Michael, once Hamas carries out the October 7th attacks in an effort to destroy a status quo that it thinks is leaving them less and less relevant, more and more hopeless,
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克尔，一旦哈马斯为了破坏它认为使其越来越无关紧要、越来越绝望的现状而发动10月7日袭击，

sentences.en: including potentially this prospect that Saudi Arabia is going to normalize relations with Israel,
sentences.zh: 包括可能存在沙特阿拉伯将与以色列关系正常化的前景，

sentences.en: what happens to these pre-October 7th negotiations between the U.S., Saudi Arabia, and Israel?
sentences.zh: 美国、沙特阿拉伯和以色列之间这些10月7日之前的谈判会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think there was a snap assumption that these talks were dead and buried, that they couldn't possibly survive a cataclysm like this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为当时有一种突如其来的假设，认为这些谈判已经彻底破裂，它们不可能在这样的灾难中幸存下来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But then something surprising happened.
sentences.zh: 但随后发生了一些令人惊讶的事情。

sentences.en: It became clear that all the parties were still determined to pull off the normalization.
sentences.zh: 很明显，所有各方仍然决心实现正常化。

sentences.en: And most surprisingly of all, perhaps, was the continued eagerness of Saudi Arabia, which publicly was professing outrage over the Israeli response to the Hamas attacks,
sentences.zh: 最令人惊讶的或许是沙特阿拉伯持续的渴望，它公开对以色列对哈马斯袭击的回应表示愤怒，

sentences.en: but privately was still very much engaged in these conversations and trying to move them forward.
sentences.zh: 但私下里仍然非常积极地参与这些对话，并试图推动它们向前发展。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And in fact, what has happened is that the scope of this effort has grown substantially.
sentences.zh: 事实上，发生的情况是，这项努力的范围已经大幅扩大。

sentences.en: October 7th didn't kill these talks.
sentences.zh: 10月7日并没有终结这些谈判。

sentences.en: It actually made them bigger, more complicated, and some people would argue more important than ever.
sentences.zh: 它实际上使谈判规模更大、更复杂，有些人甚至会说比以往任何时候都更重要。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 而且我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作《拼字蜜蜂》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Michael, walk us through what exactly happens to these three-way negotiations after October 7th
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，请为我们梳理一下，10月7日之后，这些三方谈判到底发生了什么，

sentences.en: that ends up making them, as you just said, more complicated and more important than ever.
sentences.zh: 最终导致它们正如你刚才所说，变得比以往任何时候都更加复杂，也更加重要。

sentences.en: Well, it's more important than ever because of the incredible need in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 嗯，之所以比以往任何时候都重要，是因为加沙地区有着极其迫切的需求。

sentences.en: And it's going to take a deal like this and the approval of Saudi Arabia to unlock the kind of massive reconstruction project required to essentially rebuild Gaza from the rubble.
sentences.zh: 要启动那种从废墟中重建加沙所需的庞大重建工程，就需要达成这样的协议，并获得沙特阿拉伯的批准。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia and its Arab friends are also going to be instrumental in figuring out how Gaza is governed.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯及其阿拉伯盟友也将在确定加沙如何治理的问题上发挥关键作用。

sentences.en: And they might even provide troops to help secure it.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至可能提供军队来帮助维持治安。

sentences.en: None of those things are going to happen without a deal like this.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这样的协议，这些事情都不可能发生。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太引人入胜了。

sentences.en: But this is all much more complicated now because the price for a deal like this has gone up.
sentences.zh: 但现在这一切变得复杂多了，因为达成此类协议的代价已经提高了。

sentences.en: And by price, you mean?
sentences.zh: 你说的“代价”是指？

sentences.en: What Israel would have to give up.
sentences.zh: 以色列必须放弃的东西。

sentences.en: From Saudi Arabia's perspective, you have an Arab population that is furious at Israel.
sentences.zh: 从沙特阿拉伯的角度来看，他们的阿拉伯民众对以色列感到愤怒。

sentences.en: It now feels like a really hard time to do a normalization deal with the Israelis.
sentences.zh: 现在看来，与以色列人达成关系正常化协议的时机非常艰难。

sentences.en: It was never going to be easy.
sentences.zh: 这本来就不容易。

sentences.en: But this is about as bad a time to do it as there has been in a generation at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 但这至少是这一代人以来，达成该协议最糟糕的时机。

sentences.en: And I think that President Biden and the people around him understand that the status quo between Israel and the Palestinians is intolerable.
sentences.zh: 我认为拜登总统和他身边的人都明白，以色列和巴勒斯坦之间的现状是无法容忍的。

sentences.en: And it is going to lead to chaos and violence indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 这只会导致无休止的混乱和暴力。

sentences.en: So now you have two of the three parties to this agreement, the Saudis and the Americans, basically asking a new price after October 7th.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，该协议的三方中有两方——沙特和美国——在10月7日之后基本上提出了新的要价。

sentences.en: And saying to the Israelis, if we're going to do this deal, it has to not only do something for the Palestinians, it has to do something really big.
sentences.zh: 他们对以色列人说，如果我们想达成这项协议，它不仅要为巴勒斯坦人做点什么，而且必须是真正重大的举措。

sentences.en: You have to commit to the creation of a Palestinian state.
sentences.zh: 你们必须承诺建立一个巴勒斯坦国。

sentences.en: Now, I'll be specific and say that what you hear the Secretary of State, Antony Blinken, say is that the agreement has to include an irreversible,
sentences.zh: 具体来说，国务卿安东尼·布林肯所说的是，该协议必须包含一条不可逆转的、

sentences.en: time-bound path to a Palestinian state.
sentences.zh: 有时间限制的通往巴勒斯坦国之路。

sentences.en: We don't know exactly what that looks like, but it's some kind of a firm commitment, the likes of which the world and certainly the Israelis have not made before.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道具体是什么样子，但它必须是一种坚定的承诺，是全世界，当然也包括以色列人，此前从未做过的承诺。

sentences.en: Something that was very much not present in the pre-October 7th vision of this negotiation.
sentences.zh: 这在10月7日之前的谈判愿景中是完全不存在的。

sentences.en: So much so that, as we just talked about, the Palestinians were left feeling completely out in the cold and furious at it.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，正如我们刚才所谈到的，巴勒斯坦人感到被完全冷落，并对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There was no sign that people were thinking that ambitiously about the Palestinians in this deal before October 7th.
sentences.zh: 在10月7日之前，没有任何迹象表明人们在这次协议中对巴勒斯坦人的考虑如此雄心勃勃。

sentences.en: And the Palestinians certainly felt like they weren't going to get much out of it.
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦人当然觉得他们从中得不到什么好处。

sentences.en: And that has completely changed now.
sentences.zh: 而现在情况已经完全改变了。

sentences.en: So, Michael, once this big new dimension after October 7th, which is the insistence by Saudi Arabia and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克尔，一旦有了10月7日之后这个巨大的新维度，也就是沙特阿拉伯和美国坚持要求

sentences.en: that there be a Palestinian state or a path to a Palestinian state,
sentences.zh: 建立一个巴勒斯坦国或通往巴勒斯坦国的路径，

sentences.en: what is the reaction specifically from Israel, which is, of course, the third major party, to this entire conversation?
sentences.zh: 作为当然的第三大方，以色列对整个对话的反应具体是什么？

sentences.en: Well, Israel, or at least its political leadership, hates it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，以色列，或者至少是其政治领导层，对此非常反感。

sentences.en: You know, this is just an extremely tough sell in Israel.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这在以色列极难推销。

sentences.en: It would have been a tough sell before October 7th.
sentences.zh: 即使在10月7日之前，这也很难推销。

sentences.en: It's even harder now.
sentences.zh: 现在就更难了。

sentences.en: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is completely, unrepentantly open in saying that there's not going to be a Palestinian state on his watch.
sentences.zh: 总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡毫不掩饰地公开表示，在他任内不会有巴勒斯坦国。

sentences.en: He won't accept it.
sentences.zh: 他不会接受。

sentences.en: He says that it's a strategic risk to his country.
sentences.zh: 他说这对他的国家构成了战略风险。

sentences.en: He says that it would, in effect, reward Hamas.
sentences.zh: 他说这实际上是在奖励哈马斯。

sentences.en: His argument is that terrorism has forced a conversation about statehood onto the table that wasn't there before October 7th.
sentences.zh: 他的论点是，恐怖主义强行将国家地位问题摆上了台面，而这在10月7日之前是不存在的。

sentences.en: Sure, it's always in the background.
sentences.zh: 当然，它一直存在于背景中。

sentences.en: It's a perennial issue in global affairs.
sentences.zh: 这是全球事务中一个长期存在的问题。

sentences.en: But it was not something, certainly, that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但它肯定不是美国

sentences.en: and Israel's Arab neighbors were actively pushing.
sentences.zh: 和以色列的阿拉伯邻国当时积极推动的事情。

sentences.en: Netanyahu also has, you know, he governs with the support of very right-wing members of a political coalition that he has cobbled together.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡还有一点，你知道，他是在他拼凑起来的政治联盟中非常右翼成员的支持下进行统治的。

sentences.en: And that coalition is quite likely to fall apart if he does embrace a Palestinian state or a path to a Palestinian state.
sentences.zh: 如果他真的拥抱巴勒斯坦国或通往巴勒斯坦国的路径，那个联盟很可能会分崩离析。

sentences.en: Now, he might be able to cobble together some sort of alternative, but it creates a political crisis for him.
sentences.zh: 现在，他或许能拼凑出某种替代方案，但这会为他制造一场政治危机。

sentences.en: And finally, you know, I think in any conversation about Israel, it's worth bearing in mind something you hear from senior U.S.
sentences.zh: 最后，你知道，我认为在任何关于以色列的对话中，都值得记住你从美国高级官员那里听到的一些话，

sentences.en: officials these days, which is that although there is often finger-pointing at Netanyahu and a desire to blame Netanyahu as this obstructionist who won't agree to deals,
sentences.zh: 那就是，尽管人们经常指责内塔尼亚胡，并希望将他视为那个不愿达成协议的阻挠者，

sentences.en: what they say is Netanyahu is largely reflecting his population and the political establishment of his country,
sentences.zh: 但他们说，内塔尼亚胡在很大程度上反映了他的民众和他国家的政治体制，

sentences.en: not just the right-wingers in his coalition who are clearly extremist,
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是他联盟中那些显然是极端分子的右翼人士，

sentences.en: but actually the prevailing views of the Israeli public and the Israeli public and their political leaders across the spectrum right now with few exceptions
sentences.zh: 实际上，以色列公众以及各派政治领导人目前的主流观点，除少数例外，

sentences.en: are not interested in talking about a Palestinian state when there are still dozens and dozens of Israeli hostages in tunnels beneath Gaza.
sentences.zh: 在加沙地下的隧道里还有几十名以色列人质的情况下，他们对谈论巴勒斯坦国不感兴趣。

sentences.en: So it very much looks like this giant agreement that once seemed doable before October 7th might be more important to everyone involved than ever,
sentences.zh: 所以看起来，这个曾经在10月7日之前看似可行的巨大协议，对所有相关方来说可能比以往任何时候都更重要，

sentences.en: given that it's a plan for rebuilding Gaza and potentially preventing future October 7th from happening.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这是一个重建加沙并可能防止未来再次发生10月7日事件的计划。

sentences.en: But because of this higher price that Israel would have to pay, which is the acceptance of a Palestinian state,
sentences.zh: 但由于以色列必须支付更高的代价，即接受一个巴勒斯坦国，

sentences.en: it seems from everything you're saying that this is more and more out of reach than ever before.
sentences.zh: 从你所说的一切来看，这似乎比以往任何时候都更加遥不可及。

sentences.en: And hard to imagine happening in the immediate future.
sentences.zh: 而且很难想象在不久的将来会发生。

sentences.en: So if the people negotiating it are being honest, Michael, are they ready to acknowledge that it doesn't look like this is going to happen?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果谈判的人是诚实的，迈克尔，他们准备好承认这看起来不会发生吗？

sentences.en: Well, not quite yet.
sentences.zh: 嗯，还不完全是。

sentences.en: As time goes by, they certainly say it's getting harder and harder.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们当然会说这变得越来越难了。

sentences.en: But they're still trying.
sentences.zh: 但他们仍在尝试。

sentences.en: They still think there's a chance.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然认为还有机会。

sentences.en: But both the Saudis and the Biden administration understand that there's very little time left to do this.
sentences.zh: 但沙特和拜登政府都明白，留给他们做这件事的时间已经不多了。

sentences.en: Well, what do you mean there's very little time left?
sentences.zh: 那么，你说的“时间不多了”是什么意思？

sentences.en: It would seem like time might benefit this negotiation in that it might give Israel distance from October 7th to think potentially differently about a Palestinian state.
sentences.zh: 看起来时间可能对这次谈判有利，因为它可能会让以色列与10月7日拉开距离，从而可能对巴勒斯坦国问题有不同的思考。

sentences.en: Potentially.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: But Saudi Arabia wants to get this deal done in the Biden administration because Mohammed bin Salman has concluded this has to be done under a Democratic president.
sentences.zh: 但沙特阿拉伯希望在拜登政府任内完成这项协议，因为穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼已经断定，这必须在民主党总统任内完成。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because Democrats in Congress are going to be very reluctant to approve a security agreement between the United States and Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 因为国会的民主党人会非常不情愿批准美国和沙特阿拉伯之间的安全协议。

sentences.en: It's important to understand that if there is a security agreement, that's something Congress is going to have to approve.
sentences.zh: 重要的是要明白，如果有一项安全协议，那是国会必须批准的。

sentences.en: And you're just not going to get enough Democrats in Congress to support a deal with Saudi Arabia,
sentences.zh: 你不可能在国会获得足够的民主党人支持与沙特阿拉伯达成协议，

sentences.en: who a lot of Democrats don't like to begin with because they see them as human rights abusers.
sentences.zh: 很多民主党人本来就不喜欢沙特，因为他们认为沙特侵犯人权。

sentences.en: But if a Democratic president is asking them to do it, they're much more likely to go along.
sentences.zh: 但如果是一位民主党总统要求他们这样做，他们就更有可能顺从。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Saudi Arabia fears that if Biden loses and Trump is president,
sentences.zh: 所以沙特阿拉伯担心，如果拜登输了，特朗普当选总统，

sentences.en: that those same Democrats would balk at this deal in a way that they wouldn't if it were being negotiated under President Biden.
sentences.zh: 那么同样的民主党人会以一种在拜登总统任内谈判时不会有的方式来阻挠这项协议。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Now, from President Biden's perspective, politically, think about a president who's running for reelection, who is presiding right now over chaos in the Middle East,
sentences.zh: 现在，从拜登总统的政治角度来看，想想一位正在竞选连任的总统，他目前正主持着中东的混乱局面，

sentences.en: who doesn't seem to have good answers for the Israeli-Palestinian question.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎对巴以问题没有好的答案。

sentences.en: This is an opportunity for President Biden to deliver what could be, at least what he would present as a diplomatic masterstroke that does multiple things at once,
sentences.zh: 这对拜登总统来说是一个机会，可以实现他所呈现的、至少是他会将其作为外交杰作的东西，同时完成多项任务，

sentences.en: including creating a new pathway for Israel and the Palestinians to coexist, to break through the logjam, even as he's also improving Israel's relations with Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 包括为以色列和巴勒斯坦共存开辟一条新途径，打破僵局，同时他也改善了以色列与沙特阿拉伯的关系。

sentences.en: So Biden and the Crown Prince hope that they can somehow persuade Bibi Netanyahu that in spite of all the reasons that he thinks this is a terrible idea,
sentences.zh: 所以拜登和王储希望他们能以某种方式说服比比·内塔尼亚胡，尽管他认为这是一个糟糕的主意，

sentences.en: that this is a bet worth taking on Israel's and the region's long-term security and future.
sentences.zh: 但这对于以色列和该地区的长期安全与未来来说，是一场值得下的赌注。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, no one has explained very clearly exactly how this is going to work, and it's probably going to require artful diplomacy,
sentences.zh: 现在，没有人非常清楚地解释这到底将如何运作，这可能需要巧妙的外交，

sentences.en: possibly even a scenario where the Israelis would agree to something that maybe means one thing to them and means something else to other people.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能出现这样一种情况：以色列人同意了某件事，而这件事对他们来说可能意味着一回事，对其他人来说则意味着另一回事。

sentences.en: But Biden officials refuse to say that it's hopeless, and they refuse to essentially take Netanyahu's preliminary nose for an answer,
sentences.zh: 但拜登政府官员拒绝说这毫无希望，他们拒绝接受内塔尼亚胡初步的否定回答，

sentences.en: and they still see some way that they can thread this incredibly narrow needle.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然看到某种方式可以穿过这根极其狭窄的针眼。

sentences.en: Michael, I'm curious about a constituency that we haven't been talking about because they're not at the table in these discussions that we are talking about here,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我很好奇一个我们还没有谈到的选民群体，因为他们没有参与我们在这里讨论的这些讨论，

sentences.en: and that would be Hamas.
sentences.zh: 那就是哈马斯。

sentences.en: How does Hamas feel about the prospect of such a deal like this ever taking shape?
sentences.zh: 哈马斯对达成这样一项协议的前景有何感想？

sentences.en: Do they see it as any kind of a victory and vindication for what they did on October 7th?
sentences.zh: 他们是否将其视为对他们在10月7日所作所为的某种胜利和辩护？

sentences.en: So it's hard to know exactly what Hamas' leadership is thinking.
sentences.zh: 所以很难确切知道哈马斯领导层在想什么。

sentences.en: I think they can feel two things.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们可以有两种感受。

sentences.en: I think they can feel, on the one hand,
sentences.zh: 一方面，我认为他们会觉得，

sentences.en: that they have established themselves as the champions of the Palestinian people who struck a blow against Israel and against a diplomatic process that was potentially going to leave the Palestinians out in the cold.
sentences.zh: 他们已经确立了自己作为巴勒斯坦人民捍卫者的地位，打击了以色列，也打击了一个可能将巴勒斯坦人冷落的外交进程。

sentences.en: At the same time, Hamas has no interest in the kind of two-state solution that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，哈马斯对美国试图推动的那种“两国方案”毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: is trying to promote.
sentences.zh: 他们认为以色列应该被摧毁。

sentences.en: They think Israel should be destroyed.
